package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type dialogJobIntakeRepository struct {
	repository.TeacherDialogJob
	job       domain.TeacherDialogJob
	processed bool
}

func (stub *dialogJobIntakeRepository) Accept(_ context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	stub.job = job
	return stub.processed, nil
}

type dialogClock struct{ value time.Time }

func (clock dialogClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.value }

func TestIntakeDurablyQueuesActionRequestBeforeAcknowledgement(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	jobs := &dialogJobIntakeRepository{processed: true}
	intake := teacherdialog.Intake{Jobs: jobs, Clock: dialogClock{value: now}}

	processed, err := intake.Handle(context.Background(), validDialogRequest())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued, jobs.job.Status)
	require.Equal(t, now, jobs.job.AcceptedAt)
}

func TestIntakeDurablyQueuesGeneralTeacherContext(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	jobs := &dialogJobIntakeRepository{processed: true}
	intake := teacherdialog.Intake{Jobs: jobs, Clock: dialogClock{value: now}}
	request := validDialogRequest()
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	request.ContextID = ""
	request.LearningActionID = ""

	processed, err := intake.Handle(context.Background(), request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued, jobs.job.Status)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.job.ErrorCode)
}

func validDialogRequest() domain.DialogTeacherRequest {
	return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 4, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 2,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 8, 59, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}
